# NanoIdError

Why an identifier could not be generated.

```rux
pub variant NanoIdError {
    AlphabetTooSmall,
    AlphabetTooLarge,
    DuplicateCharacter(uint),
    NonAsciiCharacter(uint),
    Entropy(EntropyError)
}
```

Failure-only: a filled destination is the success channel of `! NanoIdError`. Copy, owning nothing. The alphabet
cases are found before any random bytes are requested, so they never consume entropy.

## Cases

| Name                       | Description                                                                                                                                                |
| -------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `AlphabetTooSmall`         | The alphabet has fewer than two characters, so an identifier from it carries no information.                                                               |
| `AlphabetTooLarge`         | The alphabet has more than 256 characters, more than one random byte can choose between.                                                                   |
| `DuplicateCharacter(uint)` | A character appears twice, which would make it twice as likely as the rest. The offset is the second occurrence.                                           |
| `NonAsciiCharacter(uint)`  | A byte outside ASCII. The offset is that byte. Each character of an identifier is one byte, which a character that takes several bytes in UTF-8 cannot be. |
| `Entropy(EntropyError)`    | The operating system could not supply random bytes, for the reason carried.                                                                                |
